MissionBlock.description2: We observed an industry plagued by unpredictable scheduling, inconsistent results, and harsh, toxic chemicals. We chose a different path. By combining industrial-grade extraction engineering with rigorously vetted hospitality professionals, we transform residential and commercial properties into pristine, deeply sanitized environments.

screening.title: Rigorous Background Screening
screening.subtitle: Identity & Trust Verification
screening.description: Every single professional undergoes multi-level identity verification, criminal background history checks, and exhaustive personal reference vetting before ever putting on our uniform.

academy.title: Professional Training at Hilli Tämizlik
academy.subtitle: Hands-on Specialization
academy.description: We do not hire unverified freelancers. All team members undergo 40 hours of practical instruction on premium surface management, advanced fabric extraction mechanics, and chemical safety.

EquipmentBlock.description: We invest heavily in the latest European extraction machinery, thermal sterilization, and environmentally responsible chemistry to ensure your space is not just visually spotless, but biologically sanitized.

machinery.title: Pro-Grade Extraction
machinery.subtitle: Industrial Machinery
machinery.description: Injection-suction technology that pulls embedded dirt and allergens from the deepest fabric layers.

chemistry.title: Green Chemistry
chemistry.subtitle: 100% Non-Toxic
chemistry.description: Biodegradable, hospital-grade agents safe for children, pets, and delicate architectural finishes.

air-quality.title: HEPA Purification
air-quality.subtitle: Active Air Scrubbing
air-quality.description: Certified HEPA filtration systems that actively capture 99.97% of micro-particles while we clean.

steam.title: Thermal Sterilization
steam.subtitle: 200°C Dry Steam
steam.description: High-pressure dry steam application that instantly eradicates bacteria and lifts hardened grease without chemicals.

microfiber.title: Zonal Microfiber
microfiber.subtitle: Zero Cross-Contamination
microfiber.description: Strict color-coded fiber systems ensuring bathroom textiles never touch kitchen or living space surfaces.
